regions.today: Some bright spells at first this afternoon, but cloud will increase from the west, becoming cloudy towards evening with outbreaks of rain. Highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees, with mostly light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with outbreaks of rain and drizzle. Clear spells and scattered showers will develop behind the rain. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees, with moderate southwest winds, fresher along the coast.
regions.tomorrow: Rather cloudy with scattered showers at first. Showers will become more isolated, with sunny spells developing at times through the day. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees, with moderate to fresh westerly winds, stronger along the coast.
